# Decide Football

> Managers' and head coaches' decisions in association football. Football means the world game, not American football.

## Reference

- [Tactics glossary](https://decidefootball.com/tactics-glossary/): citable definitions of the low block, mid block, high press, counter-press, double pivot, single pivot, box midfield, inverted full-back and false nine. CSV at https://decidefootball.com/tactics-glossary/football-tactics.csv
- [What is a false nine?](https://decidefootball.com/news/what-is-a-false-nine/)
- [What is a double pivot?](https://decidefootball.com/news/double-pivot-explained/)
